abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered device did not provide a valid identifier.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Address and token verified. Settings saved; the integration is reloading.
abort.reauth_successful: Access restored. The integration is reloading.
abort.entry_not_found: This integration entry was removed. Close this form.
abort.missing_identity: The saved gateway has no device identity. Settings were not changed.
abort.entry_changed: Settings changed during validation. Open the form again.

error.invalid_auth: The LAN token does not match the gateway. Copy this ShevLogger's token from SmartShev.
error.missing_bearer: The gateway did not receive an authorization header. Check the address and direct access without a proxy.
error.auth_rejected: Access was refused without a specific reason. Check the ShevLogger address and LAN token.
error.invalid_host: Enter the ShevLogger IPv4 address or hostname. HTTP port 80 is used; no path, password or URL parameters.
error.token_required: Paste this ShevLogger's LAN token from SmartShev.
error.wrong_device: A different ShevLogger answered at this address. Settings were not changed.

confirm.description: Copy the LAN access token from SmartShev to add {name}.
confirm.title: Add discovered ShevLogger

user.description: Enter the local address and LAN access token from SmartShev gateway settings.
user.title: Connect ShevLogger

reconfigure.title: Edit ShevLogger address or token
reconfigure.description: Enter this gateway's address. Leave the token blank to keep the saved token, or paste a replacement from SmartShev → Features → Integrations → Home Assistant. Sensors and automations are preserved.

reauth_confirm.title: Restore ShevLogger access
reauth_confirm.description: Check the address and paste this gateway's LAN token from SmartShev → Features → Integrations → Home Assistant. Do not delete the integration: validation updates the existing connection.
